injuries.detail: Prince (knee) underwent surgery to address lingering issues and has no timeline for a return, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.
Holland (knee) has been upgraded to doubtful for Friday's game against Toronto, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.
Okorie (oblique) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Toronto.
Cunningham (knee) is expected to play in Friday's game against the Raptors, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.
Onyenso agreed to a two-way contract with the Pistons on Thursday.
Robinson will be re-evaluated in one week due to a left quadriceps strain, Coty M. Davis of The Detroit News reports.
Duren (hamstring) has begun on-court activity and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.
Leonard (knee) could return in the next few weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
Murray-Boyles (concussion) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pistons.
Barrett has been diagnosed with a right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Knicks, Zulfi Sheikh of Sportsnet.ca reports.
